summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY who builds Machine Learning systems from design through iteration to Model Deployment. Built a GPT-2 style LLM and Whisper-style ASR from scratch in PyTorch, and deployed a voice-driven assistant chaining faster-whisper STT, Gemini intent classification and TensorRT vision at ~11.5s end to end. Led a team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced member.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by fine-tuning DONUT (OCR-free document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built Machine Learning pipelines in PyTorch with the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added special tokens and resized the decoder embedding layer.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images to 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation after curating and annotating the dataset end to end.
Shipped Model Deployment to mobile by exporting the trained model to ONNX and TFLite.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Took over as lead of a 7-person team as the sole ML-experienced student; restructured tasks and delivered the full pipeline in 6 weeks.
Trained U-Net segmentation (VGG-16, VGG-19, ResNet-50 backbones) on BraTS 2020 MRI; scored Dice and IoU and reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Used GitLab Version Control and JupyterHub for collaborative Python data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency after resolving 11 integration failures across a Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO server and Jetson controller.
Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms) and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms) for an LLM-driven voice assistant.
Deployed the Jetson-side bridge as a systemd service with auto-restart, non-root isolation and environment-file config.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Achieved 15% WER on 1,000 Indian-English samples (NPTEL 2020) with a mel encoder and 4-block causal Transformer decoder built from scratch.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend, a 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python (6M characters in 15 minutes).

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style LLM from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm and weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and a training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Cut GPU memory ~55% with 8-bit quantization (LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; <1% accuracy degradation and +0.09 perplexity across HellaSwag, GSM8K and ARC.
